gen-gf-unica-one-gf-liter: Punchy, big-eyed letters with daylight showing in every curve, all drawn in one thickness. Liter, in sans-serif dress, adds tall lowercase and no stroke contrast, a quieter voice beside that loud one.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mada: Unica One shows its strength in strokes whose ends are as wide as the middle. And Mada, the sans-serif, earns its keep with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Commanding from the first letter, Unica One keeps every curve open to daylight. Mochiy Pop One, the sans-serif below, hangs big-eyed letters like clothespins on a long line, a loose rhythm under that firm opening.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mozilla-headline: Unica One builds round letters whose walls match its straight strokes. Mozilla Headline, a sans-serif body of big-bodied lowercase, should carry a friendly, unhurried read once the text runs on.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-nobile: Open-mouthed and contemporary, the body text keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase. Nobile, a sans-serif set beneath neon-tube Unica One, should move down a page smoothly, its arcs left unjoined like chalk.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-nokora: A very large lowercase eye, with daylight in every curve, gives Unica One its commanding look. And Nokora, plain sans through and through, lays a dark stripe of lowercase that settles into running text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans-serif with an open gap in the c, keeps capitals only slightly above lowercase. Unica One beside it feels like a stylus held at fixed pressure.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Unica One gives its n arches the full weight of the stems. Noto Sans Adlam, the sans-serif body, does its best work with curve endings kept well apart and c, s and z standing tall.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Big, bold-eyed letters with daylight in every curve and a steady line that never swells or thins, that is Unica One. Noto Sans Armenian, the sans-serif, wins on tall, full c, s and z.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Crossbars as sturdy as the stems, plus daylight in every curve: Unica One looks built to command. Noto Sans Bamum, plain sans through and through, gives each small letter a big open counter for easy flow.
